rule.name: RecursiveMapUpdate
rule.message: Change the map after its computeIfAbsent, compute, computeIfPresent or merge returns, not inside the function passed to it or a callback or same-class method that function starts: build the value there and attach the cleanup to the result (map.computeIfAbsent(key, k -> start(k)).whenComplete((r, e) -> map.remove(key, r))). A ConcurrentHashMap otherwise throws IllegalStateException (Recursive update) or deadlocks, and a HashMap throws ConcurrentModificationException.
